# exo_journal_rule (Data Source)

Look up an existing JournalRule object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `journal_email_address` (String) Maps to the -JournalEmailAddress parameter.
- `recipient` (String) Maps to the -Recipient parameter.
- `scope` (String) Maps to the -Scope parameter.
